title: Routing DSL synthesis and safety gate for staged contract migrations
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: We have multiple legacy routing rule formats (YAML blobs, ad-hoc JSON, and the older route-declarative DSL) in customer configs and infra. Migrations to the new canonical routing DSL and stricter config schema must be safe: semantics must be preserved, fallbacks must not regress latency or availability, and tier/region selections must continue to honor contractual SLAs.

Goal: Build a synthesis + verification pipeline that (1) ingests legacy routing configs and emits the canonical DSL, (2) validates semantics against a configurable test harness (golden requests and expected endpoints), (3) runs a sandboxed simulator that exercises region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variant logic across representative workloads, and (4) surfaces a safety-gate report used for staged rollouts (canary -> gradual -> full). This ticket implements the core synthesis module, the evaluator sandbox API, and the report format used by the Console rollout controller.
acceptance_criteria: Synthesizer takes legacy config inputs (old YAML/JSON/schema v0) and produces canonical DSL v1.2 with optional annotations for 'approximate mapping' where semantics are lossy.

Sandbox evaluator can replay a configurable set of requests (prefix distributions, region-affinity hints, tier constraints) and output per-request routing traces (selected region, tier, model variant, and fallback path) in the standardized report JSON.
Automated diff report compares current live routing decisions vs synthesized DSL decisions for a provided dataset and flags any decision-level mismatches >0.5% or any SLA-violating fallbacks.
Integration tests (unit + integration) added: 90% coverage for synthesis code paths and a deterministic sandbox run for the canonical test fixture (fixtures/synthesis/golden-2025-02-01.json).
Console rollout controller accepts the safety-gate report schema and can block a rollout if the report contains 'regression: true' or 'fallback_severity: high'.
Perf: initial synthesis + sandbox run for a 10k-rule customer finishes within 12 minutes on staging infra (CI job budget).

2025-02-16 Backend review (Olivia Park): We need schema versioning on the report to support future evaluator changes. Suggest adding 'report_version' and 'generator_commit'.

2025-02-18 QA (Samir Rao): Added end-to-end test matrix for region-affinity edge cases (multi-geo headers + forced-region overrides). Found a mismatch when TTL-based fallback interacts with regional capacity weights — filing ENG-162007 as follow-up dependency.
2025-02-21 Avery Chen: Implemented deterministic sandbox mode (seeded RNG) and an initial diff report exporter. Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/438

2025-02-24 Security (Lena Fischer): Quick review — no secrets in reports, but confirm that per-customer routing traces are scrubbed for PII before uploads to hosted Console. Marking security_review_required=true.

2025-02-26 Release/Console sync (Jamal Rivers): Console needs a lightweight parser for the safety-gate report. I'll add a small adapter in console-api that accepts 'routing-safety-v1' reports. Tracked in CON-889.

2025-02-28 Avery Chen: Running a 2k-rule staged migration on staging cluster; sandbox run completed, diff summary attached to ticket. Summary: 12 decision mismatches (0.6%), 1 medium-severity fallback increase. Investigating mapping rules for 'latency-prefers' flag.
